description: NaV₃F₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.54 Å. There are three inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing VF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-57°. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.16 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing VF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-57°. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.16 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.08 Å) and two longer (2.19 Å) V-F bond lengths. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent V atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two V atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂V₂ tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three V atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms.
